name: CyberCrime-Tracker (C2 panel list and search)
tier_rationale: Anonymous operator without published terms or a privacy policy (A8 unknown): 'unknown - HoneyLabs, MultiRBL (valli.org), CyberCrime-Tracker' (P170 cond 5). A promotion to community needs a recorded reviewer decision (A8), which also gates the malware_family link template (P170 cond 11).

reliability.justification: Long-running C2-panel tracker whose c2 listings P071 cond 7 rates HIGH, but the operator is anonymous and entries carry no scheme or per-entry evidence (P071 cond 9).

panel_list.title: CyberCrime-Tracker C2 panel list all.php (~870 KB, refresh daily)

terms.quote: Per-feed terms: CERT.PL Hole (any use incl. commercial; trusted), Phishing.Database (MIT), StevenBlack (MIT), MetaMask eth-phishing-detect (permissive), spmedia (MIT), Botvrij, CyberCrime-Tracker and Procon-SP run with attribution.

panel_list.notes: Research C0351 terms 'Free'; https://cybercrime-tracker.net/all.php (~870 KB, refresh daily) through the dataset manager and matched locally (disclosure 'none', P071 cond 1); entries have no scheme: host/IP pivots and path patterns as family hints (P071 cond 9). Tier unknown: a default module that declares this source fails the A3 rule, so batch p1-G03-1 keeps this feed in a non-default module class until a community promotion is recorded. Used by url_domain_blocklists.

search_pages.title: CyberCrime-Tracker search pages index.php?search= (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

search_pages.notes: Manual pivot links index.php?search={value} (research C0403 terms 'Public site.'); unknown tier: IOC values only (IP, domain, URL) with the 'unknown operator' badge (P170 cond 11). Used by pivots_threat_intel.

notes: Seeded once for batches p1-G03-1 and p2-G14-1 (P071, P170). Unknown tier: never default (A3), excluded at TLP:AMBER and above, --allow-unknown at CLEAR/GREEN, IOC_TYPES values only, neutral UA only (P326 cond 5). The panel list is ~870 KB: max_bytes 5 MB, ttl 12 h (P071 per-feed TTL 1-12 h).
